page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the left margin (Meurf., Grac. feriae, Diodor., Aelian., Hiftor.) and a few small marks in the right margin; running head at top; page number at top left; a small mark at bottom right is a digitiser's artefact and is omitted.

main_text.p: vincula sunt adempta. Athenienses sacrat Meurf. l. 1. Ben- Grac. feria-didia in honorem Dianae à Thracibus, quibus 14, Bendidis, instituta recepere, & in Piraeo, meuse Thargelione, celebravere.
main_text.head: Articulus VI.
DE ARTAXERXE OCHO.
main_text.p: IN Artaxerxe Ocho, Regum Persarum crudelissimo, de triplici ejus bello dicendum est, primum in Phoenicios defectores, quod legati in mandatis exigendis superbè se gesserint, in quo Sidon proditione Mentoris, mercenarium Ducis, rebellionis authoris (hic pollu-Diodor. l. 16. tima in Asia praefectura donatus, Hermia Atarnensium tyranno victo, urbes Regi restituit occupata, & à civibus ipsis in desperatione exuste. Alterum in Cyprios exemplo Phoenicum pecuniis, in quo insulam Evagoras & Phocion (ab hoste) Tertium contra Nectanebum Aegyptium, dicto piis Ochi sub ducibus Graecis triumphantem, qui Aelian. var. Histor. l. 6. 1. 5. auxiliantibus pòst Graecis, qui se à Nectanebo ex authoratos aegre ferebant, in Aethiopiam pulsus, & urbes receptae, moenia diruta, commeatus Aegyptiorum ablata, & magna post redemptionem, Ulus est insigni opera Bagoae Eunuchi, quo terfectus, cadaver fel bus projectum, oblatio diorum manubria conversa sunt.
main_text.head: CONTEMPORANEA.
main_text.p: De JUDAEA nil habeo, quod dicam.

page.notes: Text is faint and partly obscured by show-through and damage at right; several words in the central column are uncertain and may be misread. The marginal notes at left are partly illegible. The Latin in the right-hand area near "pecuniis", "Phocion", "Nectanebo" and "Bagoae" is doubtful. Page furniture: the running head and page number are printed at the top.
